acceptance_criteria: Chosen option recorded; plan edges or calendar updated to match
description:
START-HERE.md says Phase 8's dashboards can ship in January and 'Only p8-quality and p8-export block launch', and the calendar puts the rest of Phase 8 in January. But p8-views (P1, not labelled post-launch-ok) blocks p9-retention, which blocks p9-privacy-doc, which blocks p10-go-live. So the step-metrics views are on the critical path before the mid-December freeze.

Options: (a) accept that p8-views is pre-launch and schedule it in December; (b) cut the p9-retention -> p8-views edge (retention aggregates defined independently of the analytics views); (c) make retention post-launch-ok, since the first raw events are not due for aggregation until 12 months after a class ends.

Filed during beads setup (prompt 01, step 8).
title: DECISION: p8-views is launch-blocking, but START-HERE says only p8-quality and p8-export are
